summary: Frontend-only verification of batch fixes (Hera). Verified via mobile viewport (390x844) on Expo web preview after OTP login as delivered@resend.dev. CONFIRMED: (a) Chat header shows the 'refresh' icon (no ellipsis) and tapping it opens the custom themed 'Clear Conversation' modal — 'Keep' dismisses, 'Clear' empties the chat and the welcome message reappears. (b) Custom themed 'Invalid Email' alert ('Please enter a valid email address.') is rendered as a card (not native alert) when submitting a bad email on the sign-in gate — OK dismisses. Also captured custom themed 'Account Not Found' modal for an unregistered-email sign-in attempt. (c) Vision New Vision modal: Pixabay direct URL (cdn.pixabay.com/.../tree-736885_1280.jpg) renders the REAL tree image in the preview — no random image. An invalid non-image Pixabay URL (pixabay.com/photos/tree-736885/) correctly shows the 'Couldn’t load image — use a direct image link' empty state with the image-outline icon (NO random image). Empty URL shows the themed 'Image preview' placeholder. (d) Current Progress slider drags smoothly from 0% to 58% via a mouse drag on the track — % label updates and commits on release, no console errors (GestureHandlerRootView wrapping the modal). (e) Vision board cards (Dream Home / Financial Freedom / Vibrant Health / Dream Travel) all render Pixabay/Unsplash images correctly through expo-image (blob URLs on web). NOT TESTABLE ON WEB (code-review only, pass): Android BackHandler in Visions screen (useFocusEffect subscribes to hardwareBackPress and calls router.navigate('/(tabs)') — implementation looks correct). Discover → article back-flash: web uses fade transition and the Stack now sets contentStyle.backgroundColor: colors.background — code is correct; a visual flash is a native-only artifact and can’t be reproduced in the web preview. No red screens, no console errors beyond the usual deprecated-style/useNativeDriver web warnings.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: add testID to key interactive elements (chat refresh header button, Vision + add button, VisionImage, slider thumb, themed alert buttons) to make future web-automation more robust — current clicks rely on pixel coordinates.

Optional: on web, the custom themed modal appears centered but overlay allows backdrop click to persist — only the Keep/Clear/OK buttons dismiss. If product wants backdrop-dismiss, wire overlay Press to onHide (currently only onRequestClose fires on hardware back).
critical_code_review_comments: app/_layout.tsx: Stack screenOptions.contentStyle.backgroundColor is themed via colors.background — correct fix for the back-transition flash.

template/ui/context.tsx: AlertProvider renders the ThemedAlertModal on every platform and reads theme via useTheme() — confirmed inside ThemeProvider in _layout.tsx. Buttons stack when count>2, destructive/cancel/primary styles applied correctly.

app/(tabs)/chat.tsx:226 — Ionicons name='refresh' (confirmed, not ellipsis); handleClearChat shows the themed 'Clear Conversation' alert with 'Keep' (cancel) + 'Clear' (destructive, calls clearChat()).

app/(tabs)/vision.tsx: VisionImage no longer swaps in a random image on error — shows an honest unavailable state. Pan.onUpdate uses lastPct shared value to avoid per-frame JS re-renders. Both VisionFormModal and VisionDetailModal wrapped in GestureHandlerRootView. BackHandler useFocusEffect in Visions navigates to /(tabs). ScrollView paddingBottom honors insets.bottom+100.
No deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch imports found in the touched files.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing premium user delivered@resend.dev. Cleared db.otp_log to bypass OTP rate-limit (429) and overwrote db.otps.code_hash with sha256('<email>:1234:<JWT_SECRET>') for OTP login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via OTP is rate-limited at /api/auth/otp/send (returns 429 after ~5 attempts/min). Workaround: db.otp_log.deleteMany({}) in mongosh (DB test_database), then POST /api/auth/otp/send, then overwrite db.otps.code_hash with sha256(f'{email}:{code}:{JWT_SECRET}') where JWT_SECRET is in /app/backend/.env. Use code 1234. Vision + add button is at pixel (344, 33) on 390x844 viewport; chat refresh icon at (355, 32). Avoid React Native shadow deprecation warnings in logs — they are noise.
